blurb: Explore the sweeter and spookier side of San Diego on a walking tour through historic Old Town. Along the way, enjoy delicious churros and sweet treats while discovering fascinating stories from the neighborhood’s colorful past. Visit historic landmarks, hear tales of mysterious happenings, and learn about the people who shaped early San Diego. Discover the eerie history of El Campo Santo Cemetery and hear chilling stories surrounding the legendary Whaley House, one of Old Town’s most famous haunted landmarks. Between stops, your guide will blend local history, ghost stories, and plenty of fun with delicious tastings selected for the group. It’s the perfect combination of food, history, and mystery for anyone looking to experience a different side of San Diego.
